scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'), cp=require('child_process'); if(fs.existsSync('LedgerLine')) cp.execSync('npm install', {cwd: 'LedgerLine', stdio: 'inherit'});"
scripts.test: node -e "const fs=require('fs'), cp=require('child_process'); const cwd = fs.existsSync('LedgerLine') ? 'LedgerLine' : '.'; cp.execSync('node --test --test-concurrency=1 backend/tests/*.test.js', {cwd, stdio: 'inherit'});"
